# Toova

> A free 3D room designer that turns product photos into real-scale models so you can plan your room and see what fits before you buy.

Toova helps people place furniture and decor inside their own space at real scale. Start with a photo, get a 3D model in about thirty seconds, arrange it against your walls, then buy with confidence. Free for five rooms; Lite is $2.99/month ($29.99/year); Pro is $7.99/month ($59/year).

## Product

- Photo → 3D conversion at real-world scale
- Measured University of Chicago dorm plans (Woodlawn, North, Max P, Burton-Judson, I-House, RGG, Snell-Hitchcock)
- Free tier: up to 5 rooms
- Lite / Pro paid plans for more rooms, credits, and exports
- iOS app available
